name: kit-net.kit
about: LumaKit net.kit (lumakit.md 2.18), all on loopback inside one mod. ordered_20pct_drop: a host link and a player link through the mod's relay socket that drops one datagram in five each way (fixed sequence); 200 messages each way arrive whole and in order. peer_leaves: a second player joins the host and closes; host and first player are told, peers() drops it. clock_one_frame: the second player's clock within 1/60 s. page_served: GET / gives index.html, another path 404, a WebSocket message reaches on_page_message and page_send's answer comes back; url ends with the page's port. WAITING: K's reader for language D12.9 (service streams, director 11-12) and net.local.address in the SDK (h/net-address).
